the run stops before any hook
scan the Given, When and Then step attributes

and returns on the trait's skip tag or enabled = FALSE
driver already reached, else the first one listed
throw, naming the prerequisite and the

[a driver in the scenario's order implements it]
assertPrerequisites() for its own trait, the same
checks, run only when a scenario uses the step
each hook asks skipTag() for its own trait,
